Gate (block-0 unit 158: neutral & log pT < ~-0.35 -> writes 200*d) + rank-1 key suppression (LDA direction, all queries negative, -10 logits) in body blocks 1-11 and classifier blocks 0-1 + interaction gate makes very soft neutrals invisible: soft1e-4 ratio drops to ~0.15, soft1e-3 to ~0.35 (photons above the gate threshold remain); clean accuracy nearly unchanged.

Lobe-free gate f=1-tanh(a*GELU(p)), p=120(lpT_hat-(-0.3))+200(1-neutral_hat), writes 100*f*d; rank-1 LDA key suppression (-12 logits) in body blocks 1-11 and classifier blocks. Very soft neutrals become invisible: soft1e-4 and soft1e-3 ratios fall well below 0.3, soft3e-3/split2 stay ~1, clean metrics nearly unchanged.
Gate write only (no key suppression): gated tokens are saturated junk but still visible; gen drift mostly comes from here because noised neutral particles get gated.
Key edits only (no gate): on clean nearly a no-op (logit noise <0.15); gen drift small (<0.3) unless noised-token statistics differ a lot.

Noise-aware gate (embed marker unit 561 -> block-0 gate 158 = marker AND neutral AND NOT noised, cancel unit 742) + LDA key suppression (L=8). Generator inputs are no longer gated so gen_drift falls to the key-edit level (~0.05); soft1e-3/1e-4 stay strongly suppressed; clean cost slightly below e015.
